subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym to substitute the bracketed word in the given sentence.

So can our community leaders come up with a plan of action to help (alleviate) this problem?
solution:
The correct answer is "**Diminish**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Alleviate" means to make something less strong or bad.**(कम करना)

 
 
• ​Example: The doctor gave me an injection to alleviate the pain. 
 
 
 
• **"Diminish" means to make something less or reduce its intensity. **(घटाना)
 
 
• Example: She took a painkiller to diminish the headache.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the word "diminish" is the synonym of the word "alleviate."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "Aggravate", means to make something worse or more serious.(भड़काना)
 
• Option 2, "Falter", means to lose strength or momentum.(लड़खड़ाना)
 
• Option 3, "Altruistic", means showing a selfless concern for the well-being of others. (परोपकारी)
